definitions.gloss: to rephrase, to say in other words
definitions.explanation: To express the same meaning using different words, often to make something clearer.

definitions.gloss: in other words (when used as an expression)
definitions.explanation: Used as a transitional phrase to introduce a rephrased or clarified statement.

examples.japanese: もっと{簡単|かんたん}に{言|い}い{換|か}えてください。
{専門|せんもん}{用語|ようご}を{日常|にちじょう}{的|てき}な{言葉|ことば}に{言|い}い{換|か}えた。
examples.english: I rephrased the technical terms into everyday language.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}にもわかるように{言|い}い{換|か}えてあげた。
examples.english: I rephrased it so that even a child could understand.

examples.japanese: 「{困難|こんなん}」を「{難|むずか}しい」に{言|い}い{換|か}えると、わかりやすい。
examples.english: If you rephrase 'konnan' as 'muzukashii,' it becomes easier to understand.

examples.japanese: {外国人|がいこくじん}に{説明|せつめい}するとき、{漢語|かんご}をやさしい{和語|わご}に{言|い}い{換|か}えることが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: When explaining to foreigners, I often rephrase Sino-Japanese words into simpler native Japanese words.

examples.japanese: {言|い}い{換|か}えれば、{彼|かれ}は{断|ことわ}ったということだ。
examples.notes: [Note: {言|い}い{換|か}えれば is commonly used to mean 'in other words']

examples.japanese: {言|い}い{換|か}えると、{時間|じかん}が{足|た}りないということだ。
examples.english: In other words, there isn't enough time.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{慎重|しんちょう}だ。{言|い}い{換|か}えれば、{決断|けつだん}が{遅|おそ}いのだ。
examples.english: He's cautious. In other words, he's slow to make decisions.

examples.japanese: この{制度|せいど}は{不公平|ふこうへい}だ。{言|い}い{換|か}えれば、{一部|いちぶ}の{人|ひと}だけが{得|とく}をする{仕組|しく}みだ。
examples.english: This system is unfair. In other words, it's a structure where only some people benefit.

examples.japanese: {成功|せいこう}とは、{言|い}い{換|か}えれば、{努力|どりょく}の{結果|けっか}にほかならない。
examples.english: Success, in other words, is nothing other than the result of effort.

notes:
{言|い}い{換|か}える is a transitive verb ({他動詞|たどうし}) meaning to rephrase or express differently.

COMPOUND STRUCTURE:
- {言|い}う (to say) + {換|か}える (to exchange, to replace) → to replace one's words with different ones

ASPECT (ている):
{言|い}い{換|か}えている is rarely used; the verb is typically used in non-progressive forms.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {言|い}い{換|か}えれば (in other words)
- {言|い}い{換|か}えると (to put it another way)
- ～に{言|い}い{換|か}える (rephrase as~)
- {別|べつ}の{言葉|ことば}で{言|い}い{換|か}える (rephrase in different words)

SET EXPRESSIONS:
- {言|い}い{換|か}えれば / {言|い}い{換|か}えると: "in other words" - very common transitional phrase
